promos.title: 1.50% Low FX Conversion Fee
promos.description:
TRAVEL MORE THIS HOLIDAY, SAVE MORE ABROAD
Make every holiday purchase abroad more rewarding with a low 1.50% Foreign Currency Conversion Fee when you use your qualified RCBC Premium Visa Credit Cards for international purchases.
Effortless Savings
No registration or minimum spend required—enjoy the 1.50% FX Conversion Fee on every eligible international transaction.
PAY IN LOCAL Currency
Always choose to pay in the local currency of the country you're shopping in to maximize your savings.
Promo Period
Valid for international purchases from October 1 to December 31, 2026.
Plus, unlock seamless global spending with premium rewards and luxury airport lounge access worldwide.
RCBC Visa Infinite
Earn 5x Rewards Points for every ₱30 spent overseas
Unlimited Free Access to PAGSS International Lounges at NAIA T1 and T3* for the principal cardholder plus 1 travel companion*T3 access is valid until December 31, 2026. Learn more here.
RCBC Airmiles Visa Signature
Earn 1 Signature Airmile for every ₱25 spent overseas
Unlimited Free Access to PAGSS International Lounge at NAIA T1 for the principal cardholder
PROMO MECHANICS
The 1.50% Low Foreign Currency (FX) service fee promo is valid from October 1 to December 31, 2026, for overseas in-store or online foreign-denominated transactions charged in local currency using an RCBC Visa Infinite and RCBC Airmiles Visa Signature Credit Cards.
The Promo is open to all RCBC Visa Infinite and RCBC Airmiles Visa Signature Principal and Supplementary Cardholders in good credit standing.
To compute the Peso equivalent of the foreign transactions, convert transactions in Foreign Currency to PHP using the prevailing conversion rate × 1.50%.
SAMPLE COMPUTATION
Purchase Amount in Foreign CurrencyUSD 39.99
Conversion Rate*PHP 60.50
Peso Converted AmountPHP 2,419.40
1.50% Low FX FeePHP 36.29
Total Transaction Amount Posted to the Cardholder’s AccountPHP 2,455.69
*Conversion rates may vary daily. The conversion rate will be based on the foreign exchange selling rate of Rizal Commercial Banking Corporation at the time of transaction posting. This applies to currencies including Australian Dollar, Canadian Dollar, Euro, Hong Kong Dollar, Japanese Yen, Korean Won, Singapore Dollar, Thailand Baht, UK Pound Sterling, and US Dollar. For currencies not included in the list, the conversion rate will be based on the currency conversion rate set by Visa at the time of posting.
DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-265232 & 249414 Series of 2026
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Which card is eligible for the 1.50% low FX conversion fee promo?
The offer is exclusive to RCBC Visa Infinite and RCBC Airmiles Visa Signature Principal and Supplementary Credit Cardholders(“qualified cardholders”).
What transactions qualify for the 1.50% FX conversion fee?
Eligible transactions include international purchases made in foreign currency, whether card-present (in-store) or card-not-present (online). To enjoy this offer, qualified cardholders must always choose the currency of the country where the transaction is made. For example, if the Cardholder is shopping in France, they should choose Euro (EUR) instead of Philippine Peso (PHP) upon payment.
Are Philippine peso-billed foreign transactions eligible?
No. Transactions processed in PHP or through Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) are not eligible for the promo.
Which foreign exchange conversion rate will be applied to the transaction?
Transactions using a currency other than the Philippine Peso will be converted to PHP. The conversion rate will be based on the foreign exchange selling rate of the Rizal Commercial Banking Corporation at the time of transaction posting. This applies to currencies including Australian Dollar, Canadian Dollar, Euro, Hong Kong Dollar, Japanese Yen, Korean Won, Singapore Dollar, Thailand Baht, UK Pound Sterling, and US Dollar. For currencies not included in the list, the conversion rate will be based on the currency conversion rate set by Visa at the time of posting

promos.title: Complimentary Priority Pass membership with access to over 1,800 airport lounges and travel experiences worldwide
promos.description:
For HSBC Premier Travel customers, avail of 10 complimentary lounge visits every calendar year. For full list of airport lounges and benefits, visit prioritypass.com* 
Enjoy your free Priority Pass lounge access with these easy steps: 
1. Check participating airport lounges at https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges* or download the Priority Pass app.
2. At participating airport lounges, present your HSBC Premier Travel Card and quote “Priority Pass” or present your Priority Pass Digital Membership Card together with your boarding pass.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs): 
How many complimentary lounge access do I have? 
Premier Travel Card customers have 10 free lounge access every calendar year. This resets on January 1, every year.
How will I know which are the participating airport lounges? 
You may visit https://www.prioritypass.com/airport-lounges* or download the Priority Pass app and search for airport lounges near you.
Can I bring a guest with me to avail of the free airport lounge access? 
Yes, Premier Travel Card customers can bring a guest with them. Their guest will use up 1 complimentary access of the Premier Travel Card customers.
I’ve used up my 10 complimentary lounge access. Can I still avail of the Priority Pass airport lounges? 
Yes, you can still avail of the Priority Pass airport lounges at a rate of USD35 per visit.
See below for the Airport Lounge Terms and Conditions (full Life’s Premier Philippines App Terms and Conditions here ): 
1. Eligible Customers must present the following at the participating Priority Pass airport lounges to avail of the service:
a. HSBC Premier Travel Card and quote “Priority Pass”, or their Priority Pass Digital Membership Card; and
b. Their boarding pass.
2. For a full list of the airport lounges, you may visit https://www. prioritypass.com* .
3. Customers can extend the complimentary lounge access to a guest provided that the Customer is physically present with their guest.
4. If a Customer exceeds the complimentary lounge access entitlement provided by HSBC, they can still avail of the lounge access at a rate of USD35 per visit which will be charged to his/her HSBC Credit Card.
5. This is subject to the Priority Pass Conditions of Use found at https://www.prioritypass.com/conditions-of-use*

promos.title: Member-Get-Member Program
promos.description:
Refer now and earn incentives through Member-Get-Member Program. This offer runs from June 1 2026 to May 31, 2027. Terms and conditions apply.

Download the MGM Application Form here
PROMO MECHANICS
The Chinabank Member Get Member Program is a referral program open to Chinabank existing qualified Principal cardholders. Supplementary cardholders are not eligible to join the program.
Program Mechanics:
The Referral shall accomplish and sign the Member Get Member credit card application form and email it to mgm@chinabank.ph together with a copy of their valid government ID with visible signature. Subject should be “MGM: [full name of referral]” for example, “MGM: DELA, CRUZ, JUAN, F.”
Chinabank MGM shall acknowledge the application within 3-5 banking days, and processing will take 10-17 banking days.
The full name of the referrer and referral code should be indicated on the application form, for crediting of the cash incentives, application form with no details of the Referrer is considered invalid.
Application forms with missing information shall not be processed.
The applicants will also be updated via text message regarding the status of their application.
The crediting of incentive will be done by batch, and the incentive will be credited to the Referrers credit card on the next cycle date once their Referral is confirmed as approved.
If multiple Referrers submit the same Referral, the incentive shall be credited to the Referrer who first submitted the application. But if the first Referrer who submitted the application form has lacking minimum requirement, the next referrer with complete information and requirements shall be favored.
By participating, both the Referrer and the Referral, authorizes Chinabank to transfer and disclose their information to third-party partners for verification, encoding, and checking purposes.
Regular credit card acquisition policies shall still apply in assessing the Referral.

promos.title: Enjoy 0% installment up to 24 months with your UnionBank Credit Card!
promos.description:
Enjoy 0% installment up to 24 months at select SSI luxury brand stores with UnionBank PayEasy.

In these Terms and Conditions of the PayEasy Program, or its successor facility ("Program"), "Card" means all credit cards issued by UnionBank of the Philippines (also referred to as "we", "our", "us", “UnionBank”, or the “Bank”), while "you" or “your” refers to Cardholders whose UnionBank Credit Cards have been locally issued by us , and which are active and in good credit standing.
By availing of PayEasy, you agree to: (i) the PayEasy Terms and Conditions (the “PayEasy Terms”); (ii) the Terms and Conditions Governing the Issuance and Use of the UnionBank Credit Card (the “Credit Card Terms”); (iii) all applicable and relevant laws, rules and regulations governing the use of installment facilities; these can be viewed at https://www.unionbankph.com/cards-tc and https://www.unionbankph.com/cards-fees .
PayEasy is an Installment facility available to UnionBank Cardholders issued starting July 1, 2023 for purchases at participating merchants (the “Merchants”) which meet the required minimum purchase amount per tenor. It is subject to approval based on the available Relationship Limit or Account Credit Limit / Spend Limit, as applicable, at the time of purchase and conversion.
Under the Program, the single-receipt transaction at the participating merchants ("Merchants") using the UnionBank Credit Card shall, after the Merchant submits the transaction for settlement ("Conversion Date"), be submitted for conversion to an Installment Transaction ("Installment Transaction"). If the conversion to an Installment Transaction is approved, the UnionBank Cardholder can pay for the purchase amount ("Principal Amount") in equal monthly installments which will be billed to the credit card Statement of Account every month until the end of the term indicated in the charge slip. Otherwise, the straight single-receipt transaction will be billed in full in the next Statement of Account.
The Program is available for single-receipt purchases of at least Three Thousand Pesos (Php3,000.00) or such other amount as may be determined by UnionBank and the Merchants from time to time.
Upon your instruction to the Merchant that you would like to avail of the Program, the Merchant will swipe your UnionBank Credit Card for the purchase amount at the pre-identified terminal. If determined to be qualified, the charge slip will reflect the details of the Installment Transaction you requested (term and monthly installment amount), and your agreement to the terms and conditions of the Program.
